title: Pan-Seared British Plum Cakes
description: Moist plum cakes made with caramelized British plums, a perfect dessert for any occasion. Serve warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together the melted butter, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until just combined.
Gently fold in the caramelized British plums.
Scoop the batter into 8-10 muffin cups.
Bake for 18-20 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a cake comes out clean.
Allow the cakes to cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then transfer them to a wire rack to cool completely.
Dust the cakes with confectioners' sugar before serving.
Serve warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream, if desired.
